content: Met iei mahsen en Eimwos, silepen sihpw men sang kisin kahnimw Tekoa. Koht ketin audehkihda silepe menet mahsen pwukat sounpar riau mwohn rerrer en sahpw eh wiawi, ni mwehin Usaia, nanmwarkien Suda, oh Seropoham, nein Sehoas, wia nanmwarkien Israel.
Eri, Eimwos koasoia,

content.text: “KAUN-O mahsendihdo sang nin Nahna Saion, ni kapitie laud;
kapitie peipeido sang Serusalem, rasehng nansapwe.
oh reh kan pohn Nahna Karmel mahrdier.”

content: Sapwellimen Koht Kadeik ong Wehi kan me mi limwahn Israel
Siria
KAUN-O mahsanih, “Mehn Damaskus kan pwurupwurehngete wiewia dihp, eri, I uhdahn pahn kaloke irail, pwehki lapalahn kamakam mwuledek me re wiahiong mehn Kilead kan.
lei kahrepen ei pahn kadardiong kisiniei pohn tehnpas me Nanmwarki Asael kauwadahr oh isikada en Nanmwarki Penadad eh kelen mahwen kan.
I pahn kauwehla ewen kehl kan en kahnimw Damaskus oh kihsang kaun en Pededen oh tohn Wahun Apen. Mehn Siria kan pahn wisiklahng wehin Kir nin duwen aramas selidi kei.”
Pilisdia
KAUNO mahsanih, “Mehn Kasa kan pwurupwurehngete wiewia dihp, eri, I uhdahn pahn kaloke irail, pwehki ar salihedi tohn wehi unsek oh pangalahng rehn mehn Edom kan pwe re en kaliduwih irail.
lei kahrepen ei pahn kadardiong kisiniei pohn kehl kan en kahnimw en Kasa oh isikada ar kelen mahwen kan.
I pahn kihsang kaun akan en kahnimw Asdod oh Askelon. I pil pahn kaloke kahnimw Ekron; oh mehn Pilisdia kan me luhwe pahn mehla.”
Dair

KAUNO mahsanih, “Mehn Dair kan pwurupwurehngete wiewia dihp, eri, I uhdahn pahn kaloke irail, pwehki ar kalipelahng nan wehin Edom tohn wehi unsek. Re ahpw sohte kapwaiada inoun ehupene me re wiapene.
lei kahrepen ei pahn kadardiong kisiniei pohn kehl kan en kahnimw Dair oh isikada ar kelen mahwen kan.”
Edom

KAUNO mahsanih, “Mehn Edom kan pwurupwurehngete wiewia dihp, eri, I uhdahn pahn kaloke irail, pwehki ar kemehkihla kedlahs riarail ko, me iei mehn Israel, oh sohte men mahkohng irail. Re ahpw dadaurete nan ar lingeringer oh sohte mwahn pwilikihdi.
Iei kahrepen ei pahn kadardiong kisiniei pohn kahnimw Teman oh isikada kelen mahwen kan en Posra.”
Ammon
KAUNO mahsanih, “Mehn Ammon kan pwurupwurehngete wiewia dihp, eri, I uhdahn pahn kaloke irail; pwe ni ar kin mahmahwenki kalaudpen sapwarail ko, re pwalangpeseng lih liseian kan en Kilead.
lei kahrepen ei pahn kadardiong kisiniei pohn kehl kan en kahnimw Rappa oh isikada ar kelen mahwen kan. Ni rahnen mahweno, weriwer laud pahn mie, oh ar mahwen pahn rasehng melimel ehu. 1
Arail nanmwarki, oh sapwellime lapalap akan pahn kalipilipala.”
